### PR Checklist for Contributors & Reviewers

- [ ] **Supplementary Safety**: Changes adhere to Sentinel's supplementary early-warning safety guidelines and do not claim primary certification.
- [ ] **Offline Operation**: Core vision inference and local logging remain functional without external internet dependency.
- [ ] **Performance & Latency**: Processing stays within target detection latency (< 2.0s per frame).
- [ ] **Tests Added / Updated**: New logic includes unit or integration tests in `tests/`.
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated `README.md`, `docs/`, or configuration files where appropriate.
- [ ] **Lint & Format**: Code formatted with `black` and passes `flake8`.
